spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they've just come out of hospital

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Tariq Ellingham. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Tariq. Before I look at any account details, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And could you confirm the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see a card payment for £186.40 to Northstar Digital on 22 October. Is that the one you mean?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes. I’ve never used them. I’ve just come out of hospital, and I don’t need this stress on top of everything.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear you’ve just come out of hospital, and that this has added stress. We can take this at your pace. I can also arrange for our Financial Support team to contact you, or give you extra time for any follow-up.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Extra time would help, please. I’m unhappy because I reported it last week and didn’t hear anything.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’m logging this as a complaint about the unrecognised payment and the delay in getting back to you. I’ll take ownership of it from here.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the complaint to our complaints team today and note that you need extra time. They’ll review what happened and send you a full written response within 15 business days. I can’t promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will you contact me before then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll call you by 5pm tomorrow to confirm the complaint has been passed on and check whether you need anything else. The complaints team will then provide that full written response within 15 business days.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I’m logging your complaint today, I’ll call you by 5pm tomorrow with an update, and you’ll receive a full written response within 15 business days. You’d like extra time, and I’ll note that. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. Thanks for being patient.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Tariq. I’m sorry again you’ve had to chase this, and I’ll make sure I follow up tomorrow.
